comment: Pinned Ollama release we bundle as a Tauri externalBin sidecar. Bump this AND the per-target SHA-256 sums together. Source: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/download/v0.13.0/sha256sum.txt (signed by Ollama). v0.13.0 is the last release that still ships Linux as .tgz; v0.15.0+ switched to .tar.zst which fetch-ollama.sh doesn't decode yet.

x86_64-pc-windows-msvc._note_libs: v0.13.0+ Windows zips flatten ollama.exe to the root and ship CUDA/Vulkan DLLs under lib/ollama/. We only stage the bare .exe via Tauri externalBin (which expects a single file), so CPU inference works and GPU acceleration is a follow-up that needs Tauri resources/ for the DLL tree.
